QuantitativeValue.title: QuantitativeValue
QuantitativeValue.description: A measurement and the unit it is in. The service never sends a bare number: every value arrives beside the WMO unit code it is expressed in, and `value` is null wherever the measurement is missing rather than zero.

unitCode.description: WMO unit of measure, as a URI shorthand: `wmoUnit:degC`, `wmoUnit:km_h-1`, `wmoUnit:percent`, `wmoUnit:Pa`, `wmoUnit:m`.

anyOf.description: No measurement -- the sensor did not report, or the field does not apply to this observation.

value.description: The measurement, or null where there is none. Null is common and is not an error: an airport station reports `windGust` only when there were gusts.

qualityControl.description: Quality-control flag the observation carried: `V` validated, `S` screened, `C` coarse-passed, `Z` preliminary, `Q` questionable. Present on observations, absent on forecasts.

maxValue.description: Upper end, where the value is a range rather than a point.

minValue.description: Lower end, where the value is a range rather than a point.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: A GeoJSON position: longitude first, then latitude, in WGS 84 decimal degrees.

prefixItems.title: longitude
prefixItems.description: Longitude, decimal degrees east of the prime meridian.

prefixItems.title: latitude
prefixItems.description: Latitude, decimal degrees north of the equator.

PointGeometry.title: PointGeometry
PointGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry of a feature that sits at a single place: a station, an observation, a forecast point.

PolygonGeometry.title: PolygonGeometry
PolygonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry of an area: one outer ring, then any holes.

coordinates.description: Linear rings. The first is the outer boundary; any others are holes in it. Each ring repeats its first position as its last.

MultiPolygonGeometry.title: MultiPolygonGeometry
MultiPolygonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry of several disjoint areas -- an alert covering counties that do not touch.

coordinates.description: One entry per polygon, each shaped like `PolygonGeometry.coordinates`.

items.description: The linear rings of one polygon.

AlertGeometry.title: AlertGeometry

anyOf.description: No polygon. The common case: most alerts are issued for whole zones and counties, named in `affectedZones` and `geocode` rather than drawn.

AlertGeometry.description: The area an alert covers, when it was drawn as a polygon rather than named as zones.

CloudLayer.title: CloudLayer
CloudLayer.description: One reported cloud layer: how much of the sky it covers and how high its base is.

base.description: Height of the layer's base above the station.

amount.description: METAR sky-cover code: `OVC` overcast, `BKN` broken, `SCT` scattered, `FEW` few, `SKC`/`CLR` clear, `VV` vertical visibility (sky obscured).

PresentWeather.title: PresentWeather
PresentWeather.description: One present-weather group decoded from the station's METAR.

rawString.description: The METAR group this was decoded from, such as `-RA`.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: One observation from one station, at one moment. Every measurement is a `QuantitativeValue`, and any of them can be null.

station.description: URL of the station that reported it.

rawMessage.description: The raw METAR the observation was decoded from; empty for stations that do not report one.

textDescription.description: Short plain-language summary, such as `Mostly Cloudy`.

icon.description: URL of a weather icon for the observation.

presentWeather.description: Present-weather groups decoded from the METAR; empty when nothing was reported.

windDirection.description: Direction the wind is coming from, in degrees clockwise from true north.

windGust.description: Peak gust; null when there were no gusts.

maxTemperatureLast24Hours.description: Highest temperature in the last 24 hours; reported once a day.

minTemperatureLast24Hours.description: Lowest temperature in the last 24 hours; reported once a day.

precipitationLastHour.description: Precipitation accumulated in the last hour.

precipitationLast3Hours.description: Precipitation accumulated in the last three hours.

precipitationLast6Hours.description: Precipitation accumulated in the last six hours.

windChill.description: Wind chill; null unless it is cold and windy enough to compute one.

heatIndex.description: Heat index; null unless it is hot and humid enough to compute one.

ObservationFeature.title: ObservationFeature
ObservationFeature.description: One observation, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in.

stationIdentifier.description: Station identifier, such as `KSEA`. This is what `stations.get_observations` takes.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the station is in, such as `America/Los_Angeles`.

forecast.description: URL of the forecast zone the station is in.

county.description: URL of the county zone the station is in.

fireWeatherZone.description: URL of the fire-weather zone the station is in.

provider.description: Network the station belongs to, such as `NWS/FAA` or `MesoWest`.

StationFeature.title: StationFeature
StationFeature.description: One station, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in.

AlertReference.title: AlertReference
AlertReference.description: An earlier alert this one updates, corrects or cancels.

sent.description: When the referenced alert was sent.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: One watch, warning or advisory, in the Common Alerting Protocol vocabulary the service issues them in.

id.description: Identifier of this alert, such as `urn:oid:2.49.0.1.840.0.<hash>.001.1`. This is what `alerts.get_alert` takes.

areaDesc.description: Semicolon-separated names of the areas covered.

geocode.title: AlertGeocode
geocode.description: The areas covered, as codes rather than prose.

SAME.description: SAME (Specific Area Message Encoding) codes, one per county.

affectedZones.description: URLs of the forecast zones covered.

onset.description: When the event itself is expected to begin, if later than `effective`.

expires.description: When the alert expires unless updated.

ends.description: When the event itself is expected to end.

status.description: Whether this is a real alert. Filter on `Actual` unless you want drills.

messageType.description: Whether this issues, updates or cancels.

severity.description: How bad the impact would be.

certainty.description: How likely it is to happen.

event.description: The event name, such as `Flood Watch` or `Red Flag Warning`.

senderName.description: The issuing office, such as `NWS Seattle WA`.

headline.description: One-line summary with the times spelled out.

description.description: The full text of the alert.

instruction.description: What the public is being told to do.

parameters.description: Free-form parameters the issuing system attached: `NWSheadline`, `VTEC`, `AWIPSidentifier` and others. Every value is a list, even when it holds one item.

additionalProperties.description: The values for one parameter name.

AlertFeature.title: AlertFeature
AlertFeature.description: One alert, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in.

geometry.description: The area covered, when it was drawn as a polygon.

ForecastPeriod.title: ForecastPeriod
ForecastPeriod.description: One period of a narrative forecast: a named half-day in the twice-daily forecast, or one hour in the hourly one.

number.description: Sequence number within the forecast, starting at 1.

name.description: Name of the period, such as `Tonight` or `Wednesday`. Empty in the hourly forecast, which names nothing.

startTime.description: When the period begins, in the forecast point's own local time.

isDaytime.description: Whether this is a daytime period.

temperature.description: Forecast temperature, in `temperatureUnit`. A bare number here, unlike everywhere else in this API.

temperatureTrend.description: `rising` or `falling` where the temperature moves against the usual daily cycle.

dewpoint.description: Forecast dew point. Hourly forecasts only.

relativeHumidity.description: Forecast relative humidity. Hourly forecasts only.

windSpeed.description: Wind speed as prose with its unit, such as `5 to 10 mph`. A string, not a `QuantitativeValue`.

windDirection.description: Compass direction the wind comes from, such as `NNE`.

icon.description: URL of an icon for the period.

shortForecast.description: A few words, such as `Partly Sunny`.

detailedForecast.description: A sentence or two. Empty in the hourly forecast.

GridpointForecast.title: GridpointForecast
GridpointForecast.description: A narrative forecast for one grid cell, as a list of periods. Named for the service's own term: `/gridpoints/{office}/{x},{y}/forecast` is the gridpoint forecast.

units.description: Unit system the periods are rendered in.

forecastGenerator.description: Which generator produced it, such as `BaselineForecastGenerator`.

updateTime.description: When the underlying grid data was last updated.

validTimes.description: ISO 8601 interval the forecast covers, as `<start>/<duration>`.

GridValue.title: GridValue
GridValue.description: One value of a gridded series, and the interval it holds over.

validTime.description: ISO 8601 interval this value covers, as `<start>/<duration>` -- one string carrying both, such as `2026-09-09T01:00:00+00:00/PT1H`.

GridSeries.title: GridSeries
GridSeries.description: One gridded series: a unit and a run of intervals, each with its own value. Consecutive intervals with the same value are collapsed into one, so the series is not evenly spaced.

uom.description: WMO unit code every value is in.
